items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: He’d already recorded the tracks and he wanted me to write some overdubs on some of them.

ctx.x: I see David Byrne as someone listed that you’ve worked with.
That was just a matter of horn overdubs. He’d already recorded the tracks and he wanted me to write some overdubs on some of them.
And so he would send you the recording?
